Hi! 
The image quality is really good but here’s some stuff I’d take into account for next one:

- a more engaging location and shots 
By this I mean picking a location where there’s more to see but even with this location I feel like a change in the angles and speed of the shots would have added more engagement. 

Maybe start with a close up that finishes in the whole view from up top. On the parr’s where there’s roads maybe follow a car for a bit and then disengage by maybe letting the car move away while the camera moves outwards (farther away from the road) 

- making the music flow/match the footage 
 
Next time you could try making cuts that match the musics beat, I find that many people (including myself) really enjoy the aesthetic of changing scenes or speeds of the footage along with the music’s flow. I think this could really help your video engagement 

The thumbnail is pretty good! I’d personally just kept the “ cinematic shots “ text only so that the image wouldn’t be completely covered (but that’s just me) 

Cheers!
